chunks: You were not present on the side of Mount Sinai when We called. And all this (knowledge that you are given) is by the grace of your Lord so that you may warn a people to whom no admonisher had come before you, that they may take heed;
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Prophet Muhammad not being present at Mount Sinai according to Surah Taha?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Taha clarifies that Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was not physically present at Mount Sinai during the divine call to Prophet Moses (peace be upon him), emphasizing that his prophetic knowledge and mission are a mercy from God. It highlights that he was sent to warn a people who had not previously received a warner, so that they might remember and reflect upon the divine message. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Tabarsi in *Majma' al-Bayan*, interpret this as affirming the distinctness of the Prophets' eras while underscoring the universal scope of Muhammad's mercy to those devoid of prior explicit warning.
